verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal explicitly documents Tap to Pay on iPhone (and Android) for accepting contactless payments on a compatible off-the-shelf phone with no separate reader hardware required, including a no-code Dashboard mobile app option for founders who don't want to build custom integrations. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation specifically of Tap to Pay (community evidence in the pack is about the physical reader hardware/API rather than the phone-only Tap to Pay flow).
